title: Operations Workspace
chatHelp: Check request intake, priority, scheduling, handover, and exception rules against the operational policies.
questionPlaceholder: For a planned service change, what evidence must the owner record before execution?
imagesHelp: Attach up to five PNG or JPEG images. Images provide context, not policy authority.
promptHelp: Choose a question to review a requirement, an exception, or an evidence gap.
searchPlaceholder: Search intake, urgent priority, recovery action, handover, or exceptions.

emptyRegister: No operational requests have been recorded.
evidenceAtTime: Evidence retained when this assessment was recorded
validationError: Check the highlighted fields and use the required format.
